articles.summary: A logic flaw in Avahi Simple Protocol Server ignored the configured client limit, allowing any user to open unlimited connections and exhaust memory and file descriptors, causing a system-wide denial of service for mDNS and DNS-SD.
articles.title: Avahi Simple Protocol Server DoS (CVE-2025-59529)

articles.summary: Our audit of django-allauth uncovered seven vulnerabilities, including two that enable user impersonation and others affecting token handling, email verification, and HTTP configuration. We detail how our AI-assisted scanner exposed these logic-level issues, the patches applied, and what developers should do to secure their authentication flows.
articles.title: 7 vulnerabilities in django-allauth enabling account impersonation and token abuse
